# feint.tv — BRAWLVERSE

> BRAWLVERSE is an AI-generated virtual boxing league: 8 original fighter
> characters compete in cinematic bouts with trash talk, storylines, fan voting
> and prediction markets. All visuals are AI-generated and labeled AIGC.
> Site language: English (primary) + Chinese. Currency: USD.

## What is BRAWLVERSE

AI-generated virtual boxing entertainment league. 8 fighters: IRON JAW, VIPER,
SLEDGE, MONSOON, VOLT, THE PROFESSOR, LA REINA, GOLIATH-7. Season 1:
quarterfinals (QF1–QF4), semifinals, championship. Free to watch; accounts for
voting, collecting and prediction markets. Sign-in via email, Google or GitHub.

## Tickets & pricing (USD)

- FREE FAN $0 — watch free, browse, community
- RINGSIDE $4.99/month — vote weight x3, bet limit x2, daily coins x2, early episode access, LED wall name
- BOOKER $14.99/month — vote weight x10, bet limit x5, daily coins x5, create props & stables, everything in RINGSIDE
- PROMOTER $49/month — vote weight x20, bet limit x10, daily coins x10, Booker Night invite, everything in BOOKER
- ANNUAL $199/year — everything in PROMOTER, billed yearly
- Monthly passes auto-renew, cancel anytime (effective end of period). No partial refunds.

## Prediction markets ("betting")

Fans trade YES/NO contracts (priced 1–99) on fight outcomes; winners pay 100
fight coins per contract. Prices set by LMSR automated market maker; early
sell-back allowed; 2% fee on winnings recycled. Fight coins are virtual:
no cash value, no withdrawal, no crypto exchange. Entertainment only, not
gambling. Geo-fenced: not available to mainland-China IPs. $AXON token is
never used in betting pools.

## Refunds

Cancel anytime; access runs to end of billing period. Refunds only for:
duplicate charges, charges after cancellation took effect, or full-period
outages caused by us — request within 14 days via /contact. Fight coins and
prediction entries are never refundable.

## Support

In-site live chat (Tawk.to) or https://www.feint.tv/contact. Knowledge base
covers pricing, betting rules, accounts, refunds, availability and creator perks.
